text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Owners of big companies reject calls for pay rises in private sector firms in Bahrain. GULF DAILY NEWS
- More jobs are on the way. A 1.25 million dinar water bottling plant will open in Bahrain next month.
- Bahrain firm in deal with India to promote Gulf projects.
- Bahrain's emir praises labour cooperation with Egypt.
- Foreign ministers of Gulf Arab states are due to meet in Riyadh on Tuesday.
- Seminar in Bahrain expects Islamic banking to grow between five to 10 percent.
